verdict.rationale: stagewise is a desktop agentic IDE, and an API exposing its UI capabilities is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only UI-driven features (diff review, visual element selection, @mentions) plus bring-your-own-key support for third-party model providers, which is consumption of external APIs rather than a stagewise API. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no evidence of a programmatic API, let alone UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
